primary_decree_evidence.title_from_print: Décret n° 82-1135 du 23 décembre 1982 modifiant le décret n° 46-2959 du 31 décembre 1946 et le décret n° 73-598 du 29 juin 1973 en ce qui concerne le barème indicatif d'invalidité en matière d'accidents du travail
primary_decree_evidence.article_1: Adds the barème annex reference after the first paragraph of article 124 of decree 46-2959.
primary_decree_evidence.article_2: Adds the barème annex reference after the second paragraph of I of article 29 of decree 73-598.
primary_decree_evidence.note_1: Annex publication is announced in the next Documents administratifs issue; no actual issue number or date is supplied.

next_verifiable_steps: Consult the BnF Documents administratifs microfiche annual tables for late 1982 and early 1983, using their paper/microfiche concordances to identify the issue announced on 30 December 1982.
Consult the BnF 1983 official brochure (4-FW PIECE-1627) or Cujas February 1983 edition (M/96.616-4010 ed.1983); photograph/scan the title, edition, publication/imprint and chapter6.1.6 together.
Compare that image with a verified later official edition, record all publication details and applicable version links, and only then consider a guarded corpus supplement.
